guide.caption: Fill the frame with the card and keep the printed code inside the marked strip.

permission.title: Scanning needs the camera
permission.reason: Binder reads the code printed under the artwork. The frames stay on your phone and nothing is recorded.
permission.deniedReason: Binder cannot read a card without it. Allowing it is the only thing this screen needs.
permission.blockedReason: Turn the camera back on for Binder in the system settings, then come back to this screen.

scan.noCamera: Binder found no camera on this phone, so there is nothing to scan with.

captured.label: Captured
captured.empty: Nothing captured yet. Sweep the page and cards land here.

offline.message: The resolver could not be reached. Your cards are safe and waiting.

review.openAccessible: Review flagged cards: {{flagged}} still to check
review.title: Cards to check
review.subtitle: The scanner could not settle these. Fix them while the cards are still in front of you.
review.empty: Nothing to check. Every card this sweep captured was matched to a set.

reason.refused: The server would not accept this read, so no card was looked up.
reason.ambiguous: More than one card matches. Pick the one you are holding.
reason.no_set: Found the card, but not which set it is from.

search.title: Find the card by name
search.label: Card name
search.prompt: Type part of the card's name and search.
search.empty: No card by that name. Try a shorter part of it.
search.failed: The card search could not be reached. Try again.

list.empty: No binders yet. Create one and the cards you scan have somewhere to live.
list.loadError: Your binders could not be loaded.
list.createError: The binder could not be created.

page.emptyBinder: This binder is empty. Add a card and it lands in the first pocket.
page.loadError: This page could not be loaded.
page.dragHint: Hold a card and drag it to another pocket, or onto the strip at either edge to send it to the next page. Tapping a card offers the same moves as buttons.
page.moveError: The card could not be moved.
page.removeError: The card could not be removed.
page.addError: The card could not be added.

pocket.addLabel: Pocket {{pocket}}, empty. Add a card here.

add.title: Add a card
add.searchLabel: Search the card database by name
add.prompt: Type part of a card name to search.
add.note: A card added by name is filed with no set. Scanning it records the set it was printed in.

browse.searchLabel: Search cards for sale by name
browse.loadError: The listings could not be loaded.
browse.empty: Nothing is for sale yet. Mark a card in one of your binders and it shows up here.
browse.emptyFiltered: No card for sale matches that search. Try a shorter name, or another set.

sell.listed: This card is for sale. Buyers find it in the Market tab.
sell.unlisted: This card is no longer for sale.
sell.alreadyListed: This card is already for sale, so nothing changed.
sell.listFailed: The card could not be put up for sale.
sell.unlistFailed: The card could not be taken off sale.

contact.loadError: The seller's details could not be loaded.
contact.none: This seller has not shared any contact details.
contact.copyFailed: The detail could not be copied.
contact.openFailed: This phone could not open that.
